Let's create:

TYPE ST_Recipe :
STRUCT
    recipeID : INT;
    totalRatio : REAL;
    temperature : REAL;
END_STRUCT
END_TYPE

FUNCTION_BLOCK FB
VAR_INPUT
    recipe : ARRAY[1..8] OF ST_Recipe;
    selSlot : INT;
    loadCmd : BOOL;
    running : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    valid : BOOL;
    loadedID : INT;
END_VAR
VAR
    loadCmdPrev : BOOL;
    lastValid : BOOL;
END_VAR

IF running THEN
    valid := lastValid;
ELSIF loadCmd AND NOT loadCmdPrev THEN
    IF selSlot < 1 OR selSlot > 8 THEN
        valid := FALSE;
        loadedID := 0;
    ELSIF recipe[selSlot].recipeID <> 0
          AND recipe[selSlot].totalRatio >= 99.0
          AND recipe[selSlot].totalRatio <= 101.0
          AND recipe[selSlot].temperature >= 30.0
          AND recipe[selSlot].temperature <= 180.0 THEN
        valid := TRUE;
        loadedID := recipe[selSlot].recipeID;
    ELSE
        valid := FALSE;
        loadedID := 0;
    END_IF
ELSE
    valid := lastValid;
END_IF

loadCmdPrev := loadCmd;
lastValid := valid;

END_FUNCTION_BLOCK
